title: One Fairway Golf
description: A free 3D golf game with three 18-hole courses full of terrain, water and forest, a daily hole that everyone plays once, and real-time multiplayer in stroke play, match play and 2v2 alternate shot. Currently in open beta.
how_to_play: Start as a guest, no account needed. Hold and drag up anywhere, then let go to start the swing, and click again as the marker meets the gold line. Works with a mouse or touch.
